checks.title: Label or definition minted by the transformation
checks.description: A mapping states a skos:prefLabel, altLabel or definition for a term the model or taxonomy owns. Two files now disagree about the term's name the moment either changes, and the mapping's copy is the one that reaches the output.
checks.remediation: Delete the label from the mapping and let the taxonomy supply it.
checks.cucumber_scenario: Vocabulary terms are named by the vocabulary
